items.title: Fourth Press Briefing on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Search teams have recovered 1010 bodies so far, with around 4,000 people still unaccounted for. More than 11,800 people have been rescued, including 324 foreign nationals, while about 590 foreigners from 39 countries remain missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Fourth Press Briefing on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Fifth Press Briefing on Bhote Koshi Floods
items.summary: Rescue teams from India, China, and South Korea are working with Nepali forces to clear tunnels and process DNA samples. So far 1,114 bodies have been recovered, nearly 3,900 people remain missing, and about 11,993 have been rescued.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Fifth Press Briefing on Bhote Koshi Floods

items.title: Diplomatic Briefing by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs Mr Shisir Khanal on the Bhote Koshi Floods
items.summary: A huge flood hit the Bhote Koshi on August 26 and tore through Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Chitwan. So far 1,204 bodies have been recovered, 11,993 people rescued and around 4,200 remain missing, including 590 foreigners from 34 countries.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Diplomatic Briefing by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs Mr Shisir Khanal on the Bhote Koshi Floods

items.title: Sixth Press Briefing on Bhote Koshi Floods
items.summary: Search teams have recovered 1,252 bodies so far, with around 4,200 people still missing and nearly 12,000 rescued. Teams from India, China, Singapore and Korea are helping Nepali forces with the searches and DNA work.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Sixth Press Briefing on Bhote Koshi Floods

items.title: Press Briefing by the Spokesperson on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Rescue teams have recovered 903 bodies and brought more than 10,000 people to safety, including 323 foreign nationals. About 4,200 people are still unaccounted for, with 590 foreign nationals from 39 countries among the missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing by the Spokesperson on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Nepal Police — DNA profiling for unidentified remains
items.summary: Nepal Police asks relatives of people missing after the Rasuwa / Bhote Koshi floods to help identify recovered bodies through DNA. In Nepal: first-degree relatives (father, mother, son or daughter) can give a fresh blood sample plus two passport-size photos at Nepal Police Hospital Pathology Lab, Maharajgunj, or the nearest District Police Office. Abroad: get DNA profiling at an authorised forensic lab and email the report to dnacodis@nepalpolice.gov.np with the missing…
items.citation: Nepal Police HQ — Information on DNA Profiling for unidentified Dead Bodies (31 Aug)

items.source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
items.title: NDRRMA — Bhotekoshi water level rising again (31 Aug)
items.summary: On Sunday 31 August, NDRRMA warned that water levels in the flooded Bhotekoshi River had risen again and urged residents and rescue personnel in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Chitwan and nearby areas to take precaution. Agency said it would issue further updates after receiving additional information. Death toll and missing figures were also being updated on ndrrma.gov.np — always confirm on the original notice board.
items.citation: NDRRMA Nepal — public warning via official channels

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Sunday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: After the Bhote Koshi floods, search teams have recovered 734 bodies and rescued more than 8,000 people. About 2,500 remain unaccounted for, including over 400 foreign nationals.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Sunday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Over 4450 people have been rescued from the Bhote Koshi flood areas, including more than 187 foreigners, while about 2400 remain unaccounted for. Rescue teams are still searching the affected districts and getting extra help from neighboring countries.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August, causing major damage to homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. So far 538 bodies have been recovered and 511 out of 632 people from 33 countries remain missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams and helicopters are at the mudslide site near Gyirong Port, where three people have been killed and 558 remain missing. More rescuers have arrived with supplies, and work continues on an upstream blockage.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
